description: Red geodésica de Cerdanyola del Vallès is a dataset listed in IDEE, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by sig.cerdanyola.cat. Geodetic network of Cerdanyola del Vallès is a set of geographical information regarding the location of the geodesic vertices of the municipality. The spatial representation of this data is carried out by means of an interactive viewer. For each vertex of the network, a drop-down point provides additional relative information. Coverage: ES. The portal shows the English title as "Geodetic network of Cerdanyola del Vallès" (machine-translated by the portal). Its keywords include Spain, Catalunya, Geodesy, Cataluña, España, Catalonia. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support telecommunication coverage and network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-idee.
